note: Task #6 확장 — factor interaction 채널 (distress x momentum). Avramov-Chordia-Jostova-Philipov 2013 JF 'Anomalies and Financial Distress'의 한국 적용. H_1682 Q25 distress와 구분되는 signal (interaction based).

hypothesis_summary.name: Distress-Momentum Interaction Diversifier
hypothesis_summary.mechanism: Avramov 2013 JF 원논문: 'momentum anomaly는 high-distress 종목에서만 작동, low-distress에서는 약화'. 한국 inversion test: 'low-distress + high-momentum' 교집합이 가장 robust abnormal return 생성. Signal = sign(z_momentum > percentile 70) × sign(z_Q25 distress < percentile 30) × z_composite. 단순 double-sort → Top 20 EW.
hypothesis_summary.why_now: PG0 Sharpe gap 0.807 + independent alpha 4+ 확보 필요 (Blender 활성화). Factor interaction family는 factor taxonomy §9 미구축. 기존 single-factor (Q25 distress H_1682 / momentum M04 existing)와 구분되는 interaction signal. H_1682 defense용 Q25 low-buy와 다르게 H_1687은 'low-distress high-momentum' quality-momentum composite.
hypothesis_summary.expected_role_reason: Interaction signal은 (1) standalone distress와 구분(H_1682과 rho 중간 예상, S3 확인), (2) standalone momentum과 구분, (3) 'clean' momentum (distress-driven noise 제거). Diversifier role — 기존 Core/Defense strategy와 low correlation 예상.

academic_foundation.primary_reference: Avramov, Doron, Tarun Chordia, Gergana Jostova, and Alexander Philipov, 2013, 'Anomalies and Financial Distress', Journal of Financial Economics 108, 139-159.
academic_foundation.core_reference: Part A 참조번호 TBD + Avramov-Chordia-Jostova-Philipov 2013 JFE (distress x anomaly interaction foundational)
secondary_references: Campbell, John Y., Jens Hilscher, and Jan Szilagyi, 2008, 'In Search of Distress Risk', Journal of Finance 63, 2899-2939. (distress premium 음의 방향)
Ohlson, James A., 1980, 'Financial Ratios and the Probabilistic Prediction of Bankruptcy', Journal of Accounting Research 18, 109-131. (Q25 Ohlson O foundation)
Jegadeesh, Narasimhan and Sheridan Titman, 1993, 'Returns to Buying Winners and Selling Losers: Implications for Stock Market Efficiency', Journal of Finance 48, 65-91. (momentum foundation)
이일균·김동철 (2019), '한국주식시장의 재무적 곤경과 팩터 효과', 한국재무학회지 32, 457-488. (한국 distress premium 실증)
Hwang, Soosung, Byung-Seong Min, and Hannah Lim, 2020, 'Distress Momentum', 한국재무학회 working paper. (한국 distress+momentum interaction, direct cite 확인 필요)
academic_foundation.mechanism_academic: Avramov 2013: momentum anomaly는 credit rating downgrade 집중된 high-distress 종목에서 주로 발생. Low-distress 종목은 momentum 약함. → Interaction 핵심: 'momentum strong AT high-distress'. BUT 한국 실무적 adaptation: long-only + risk-averse → 'clean momentum at low-distress' 방향 선택 (downside 축소). Campbell 2008: distress premium 음 (high distress → low return) → low-distress filter가 safety floor. 합: low-distress × high-momentum = quality momentum.
academic_foundation.korean_specific: 이일균-김동철 2019: 한국 distress premium 음 (Campbell 2008 replicate). Q25 Ohlson O distress level 낮은 종목 + 12M-1 momentum 높은 종목 double-sort 전략이 개별 factor 대비 incremental alpha 입증.

core_reference: Avramov-Chordia-Jostova-Philipov 2013 JFE 'Anomalies and Financial Distress' + 이일균·김동철 2019 한국재무학회지 '한국주식시장의 재무적 곤경과 팩터 효과' (Part A에 추가 요청 예정)

base_signal.formula_step_1: z_distress_low = -z_Q25_Ohlson_O (low distress direction — signed factor, C13 통해 등록)
base_signal.alternative_gated: Gated version: ifelse(z_Q25 < percentile(30) AND z_mom > percentile(70), composite, 0)

factor_construction.ortho_method: S1: 정적 50/50 composite. S5에서 Size/BM 잔차화 + double-sort variant.

scout_notes: Task #6 확장 — factor interaction 채널. H_1682 Q25 공유이나 counterpart M04로 완전 다른 signal.
Avramov 2013 JFE는 'anomalies are strongest in distressed firms'의 foundational paper — 일반적 학계 상식과 다른 굴절. H_1687은 반대 방향 (low-distress × high-momentum = clean momentum) 적용.
한국 이일균 2019 실증 + Hwang 2020 working paper (직접 cite 재확인 필요). 한국 distress premium 음 (Campbell 2008 replicate).
S3 critical: H_1682과 Q25 공유로 rho 중간 예상. rho < 0.6 gate 통과 여부가 admission 핵심.
Diversifier fit 예상 +0.10~0.20 SR. Q25+M04 composite은 'quality momentum'으로 SR 1.0+ 가능성도 있음 (standalone).
